clause: Content-based selection: quick/selection brush, flood/magic-wand, color-range, tonal-range, luminosity [STU-RAS-018]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped content-based (non-ML) selection tools onto StudioSelectionSet: quick/selection brush (painted selection that grows to matching regions and snaps to edges, add/subtract by stroke, on-canvas overlay); color-range/magic-wand flood select (similar color/tone by tolerance, contiguous + sample-all-layers); tonal-range select (Shadows/Midtones/Highlights bands); luminosity/alpha select (from layer luminosity or content/alpha); and eyedropper color-range select (fuzziness-masked by color similarity with live preview).
expected_tests: live: magic-wand flood-selects a similar-tone region by tolerance with contiguous vs sample-all-layers; tonal-range select isolates highlights
live: luminosity select builds a selection from a layer's luminosity; color-range preview updates with fuzziness
acceptance_criteria_original: selection brush + magic-wand + color-range + tonal-range + luminosity select all produce StudioSelectionSet

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Color-range, tonal & luminosity selection

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.

Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-018]** Studio MUST provide the following deduped selection tools/commands. Each row is one primitive. *Derivation: catalogue table, splits per row; yields 12 microtasks, one per selection tool or operation.* | Tool or operation | Normative behavior | |---|---| | Geometric marquee | Rectangular, elliptical, single-row (1px), and single-column (1px) pixel selections with fixed-ratio/fixed-size constraint, draw-from-center, and proportional modifiers. | | Freehand lasso | Freehand-drawn selection boundary. | | Polygonal lasso | Straight-segment click-to-build selection. | | Magnetic lasso | Edge-snapping selection with width, contrast, and frequency controls. | | Quick/selection brush | Painted selection that grows to matching regions and snaps to edges, with add/subtract by stroke and an on-canvas selection overlay. | | Flood select (tolerance) | Selects similar color/tone from a sampled point by tolerance, with contiguous and sample-all-layers options. | | Object select | Auto-selects a detected object under a hover, rectangle, or lasso region using an on-device model, with multi-part component selection and optional matting. | | Subject select | One-command on-device selection of the dominant subject(s), recordable into a macro/batch. | | Sky select | One-command on-device selection of sky regions. | | Tonal-range select | Selects Shadows, Midtones, or Highlights tonal bands. | | Luminosity / alpha select | Builds a selection from a layer's luminosity or content/alpha for luminosity-masking workflows. | | Color-range select | Eyedropper-sampled fuzziness-masked selection by color similarity with a live preview. |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
